userStories.title: Create ~/.praxis/config.toml with documented defaults on first run
acceptanceCriteria: On first run the file at ~/.praxis/config.toml is created if missing
Default contents include [schedule] day='sunday' hour=18 minute=0
Default contents include [scan] since_days=7 max_new=200
Default contents include [judge] primary_provider='anthropic' frontier_model='claude-opus-4-7' cheap_model='claude-haiku-4-5'
Default contents include [notification] enabled=true sound='default'
Default contents include [privacy] redact_secrets=true
Existing config files are never overwritten on subsequent runs
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Typed config loader exposes all sections
acceptanceCriteria: Module exposes a load_config() function returning a typed object
All five sections (schedule, scan, judge, notification, privacy) are accessible as typed fields
Missing fields fall back to documented defaults rather than raising
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: praxis config CLI supports view, get, set, and edit
acceptanceCriteria: praxis config (no args) opens the file in $EDITOR
praxis config --get schedule.day prints the value to stdout
praxis config --set schedule.day=monday updates the TOML file and preserves other keys
Invalid dotted keys produce a non-zero exit and a clear error message
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
